scope: Forty USDT perpetual contracts, long only. Preserved source has no short-entry implementation. Fixed initial-dollar risk, no spot legs or real orders.

hypothesis.mechanism: Unchanged pinned pre2024 NFI multi-timeframe entries and management proposals, compare partial reductions with complete-position exits under identical bounded risk. No new entry factors or hindsight-selected symbols.
hypothesis.layers: Pure entry tag set61 is core; all other recognized original tag combinations small. Mixed61tags remain small. Original raw tags preserved.
hypothesis.control: NFIBoundedPartial clamps negative source adjustments to owned stake and preserves partial reductions; original full exits also retained.
hypothesis.full: NFIBoundedFullExit maps every source negative adjustment, winning or losing, to -trade.stake_amount for a complete exit.
hypothesis.dual: NFIBoundedDualExit maps a source negative adjustment to a full exit only for small sleeve if entire current campaign including prior realized cash has positive native net PNL; else bounded partial. Core remains partial.
hypothesis.risk: All2x, maximum2small/2core campaigns. Fixed initial1000*.99 reference. Per campaign small risk.001/margin.02, core risk.005/margin.20. Risk budget includes stop-price entry/exit fees with1percent stake buffer; gaps and unknown future funding can exceed budget.
hypothesis.sizing: First fill reserves one additional equal-stake fill at no higher price. Additional stake never exceeds first stake, source proposal, remaining margin, nativeavailable stake or remaining stop-and-fee budget; known negative funding deducted. Max2entries, no further entry after any exit.
hypothesis.stop: First entry locks absolute stop max6percent/4simpleATR14 small reject>12percent; core max10percent/8ATR reject>20percent. Never widen. Enable all risk exits: pinned source originally rejects ordinary stop_loss.
hypothesis.time: Close whole campaign after6hours small/72hours core, winning or losing; unchanged source full exits may happen earlier.
hypothesis.accounting: Only fully closed campaign is a win/loss. All actual fees/funding and hourly marked unrealized equity included. Partial fills never counted as separate wins. Fixed dollar budgets do not reinvest open partial profits.
hypothesis.data_causality: RawOHLCV preserved; native compact float32 original indicators; newATRfloat64. Closed5m source bar only, same causal multi-timeframe informative merges. Actual-data prefixes before accounts.
hypothesis.comparison: Run all3full2024 accounts at3bps extra cost per side, same40coins, initial1000,fee5bps per side+actualfunding. Freeze beforefirstresult; no threshold grid or posthoc entry selection.
hypothesis.metric_evaluation: Use immutable official-source metric contractv003, joint netreturn/Sharpe/hourlymarkedMDD; disclose native and proxy formulas. AlsoSortino/Calmar/PF/SQN/expectancy/consistency/recovery/costs/sleeves/frequency.

execution_schedule.discovery: Allthree2024completeaccounts at3bps, independent actualfill cash and bound audit, fullmetric scorecards; preserve failures and zero accounts.
execution_schedule.followup: OnlygenericpositivePNL/PF>=1.1/DD<=15percent/30positions with both positive sleeves advances unchanged to0/10bps and2025historicalvalidation. Joint thresholds are research assumptions; no universal officialSharpe threshold asserted.
